payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all possible numbers of euro '5-euro' units, then greedily fills the remainder with dollars, tracking the maximum spent rubles.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tries each feasible euro amount as a branch, with the dollar amount determined greedily; this resembles a degenerate branch-and-bound where the bound is implicitly the remaining rubles. No backtracking or bitmask/permutation enumeration used.
